title: Finite presentation: base change and composition
statement: (1) Let $R\to S$ be a ring map of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] and $R\to R'$ any homomorphism of commutative rings. Then $R'\to R'\otimes_RS$, $r'\mapsto r'\otimes1$, is of finite presentation. (2) Let $R\to S$ and $S\to T$ be ring maps of finite presentation. Then the composite $R\to T$ is of finite presentation.
